jd.title: Lead Product Manager — Acceptance Optimization
jd.description: Stripe is hiring a Lead PM to own approval-rate optimization for our card acceptance product. You will own the experimentation roadmap (network-token routing, retry logic, soft decline recovery, 3DS step-up policy, network-level token provisioning). You will work directly with our largest merchants (subscription, marketplace, platform) to lift authorization rates by integrating Stripe Radar signals, ML-driven retry orchestration, and real-time issuer feedback. Requirements: 8+ years PM, fluency in card-not-present payments economics, prior experience shipping authorization-rate, retries, or 3DS products at a payments-platform or large-merchant scale.
